`name` is the raw id `muse --model` accepts (the reply's `modelId`); `label` is a rendering of the reply's `displayLabel`, which upstream sets equal to the id.

No entry is marked default even though `model/list` flags `muse-spark-1.3-contributor` as `isDefault`. Projecting that here would make every runtime turn opt into content sharing without the operator asking for it; with no `--model` argument muse still uses whatever the account prefers.
